sources.title: Van Der Pas, Poppe and Van Waveren2017: Ontogenetic variability in old and new collections of Dicranophyllum gallicum
sources.notes: Primary full text and figures6,12. Narrow leaves commonly twice bifurcate; second fork wider. Helical leaf cushions and foliage distributed along slender axis, denser apex. Whole height4.5m is a mechanical woody reconstruction assumption, not fossil completeness; this smaller illustrative living specimen uses1.6m nominal axis. No roots or reproduction claimed.
